recognize_zh: G 帶染色的男性核型圖，23 對染色體（含 X、Y）數目完整、未標示箭頭，第 15 與 17 號外觀成對無明顯易位；在 APL 病例中，看似正常的核型提示 PML::RARA 可能為隱匿性（cryptic）重組。
features: 46 chromosomes with no numerical abnormality apparent
No arrows or visible structural rearrangements marked
Chromosomes 15 and 17 appear as normal pairs at this band resolution
Low-to-moderate banding resolution limits detection of subtle changes
describe_en: G-banded karyotype shows an apparently normal male complement, 46,XY, with no numerical or obvious structural abnormalities at this banding resolution. In particular, a t(15;17)(q24;q21) is not visible, and chromosomes 15 and 17 appear paired normally. In a patient with suspected acute promyelocytic leukemia, a normal karyotype does not exclude the diagnosis, because PML::RARA can arise from cryptic insertions or submicroscopic rearrangements detectable only by FISH or RT-PCR.
